hypothesis: Giving each feature field a separate embedding per interacting field (instead of one shared embedding per feature) lets user_id, video_id, author_id, tab and dur_bucket learn field-specific interaction vectors, improving within-user ranking. With k=4 (vs FM's k=16) total parameters stay comparable, so any gain comes from structure not capacity. Expect valid primary to improve to ~0.6025 (matching the verified 6-seed measurement of 0.6025 vs FM's 0.6016), a real but modest (~+0.001) gain over the FM baseline of 0.6015.
